explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/38: does there exist B, not an additive basis, such that for every A of Schnirelmann density α and every N some b ∈ B has |(A ∪ (A+b)) ∩ {1,…,N}| ≥ (α + f(α))N, with f(α) > 0 for 0 < α < 1? The statement has this shape, with f : ℝ → ℝ positive on (0,1) and one f for all A and N. `Ioc 0 N` is {1,…,N}. It uses `IsWeakAddBasis` (sums of at most k elements), per a docstring note based on [Er56, p.135]; I did not read [Er56] here, but a non-basis in that weak sense is the stronger requirement, and it is the natural reading given the page's context of essential components. The page reports a positive solution. Faithful.
